title: Party to the contract must not require excessive security deposits
description: A party to the contract must not require manifestly excessive security deposits from the consumer

content.what: must not require excessive security deposits
conditions: security deposits must not be manifestly excessive
limitations: security deposits must not cause significant change in the rights of the consumer
security deposits must not be wholly disproportionate to the loss occurred due to breach of contract
